acceptedRustFindings.name: zip
acceptedRustFindings.reason: Scoped to the unchanged Linux x64 pnpm 12.14.0 binary and exact accepted tgz stage command. Publish reads gzip/tar entries in memory and uploads the original bytes; no ZIP extraction, install, runtime download or server command. The vulnerable ZipArchive::extract / ZipStreamReader::extract APIs were not found in this publisher call path. Reassess on any version/source/target/command/advisory change.
